errors.evidence: The line for "StrmLLM (n=64)" is described as light blue, but the image shows it as a standard blue. The atom checklist also specifies the color as blue.
The line for "SepLLM (n=128)" is described as dark blue, but the image and atom checklist specify it as blue-violet.

The x-axis range is described as approximately 145,000, but the image and atom checklist specify it as 140,000. While this is within ±10% tolerance, the atom checklist explicitly states 140,000, making this a minor discrepancy.
The description omits mention of the light green line at slightly greater than 0 from the x-axis, parallel to the y-axis.
The description does not explicitly state that the blue line (StrmLLM) is slightly above all the other lines, though this is implied by the final values.
